recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有大量中至大型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質淡藍且量中等、邊緣不規則略呈毛絨狀突起，核圓至卵圓、染色質中度凝集並常見一個明顯中央核仁（類前淋巴球 prolymphocyte-like），提示 B 細胞淋巴瘤周邊血侵犯，如邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous medium to large lymphoid cells, about 2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Moderate N:C ratio with moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Irregular, focally shaggy cytoplasmic borders with short projections, often polar rather than circumferential
Round to oval nuclei, some slightly indented, with moderately condensed chromatin
Single distinct central nucleolus in many cells (prolymphocyte-like)
Red cells unremarkable; no smudge cells or granular lymphocytes evident
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have moderate amounts of pale blue-gray cytoplasm with irregular, focally shaggy borders and short, partly polar projections, and round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and a single distinct nucleolus in many cells. Background red cells are unremarkable. The morphology is that of circulating prolymphocyte-like B cells; in the context of the known diagnosis, findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by marginal zone lymphoma, with flow cytometry needed to exclude hairy cell leukemia and its variants.

ddx.vs: HCL cells have circumferential fine hairy projections, oval or bean-shaped nuclei with homogeneous chromatin and usually no nucleolus, with CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123 and BRAF V600E positivity.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: This entity combines villous cytoplasm with a prominent nucleolus similar to these cells, but is CD25-negative/CD103-positive, whereas SMZL is typically CD103-negative and CD25 variable.
MCL cells have scant cytoplasm without villous projections and are CD5-positive with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and t(11;14).

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: CLL shows small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin, scant cytoplasm and smudge cells, with a CD5+/CD23+/dim sIg phenotype.
